publisher: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
title: TSMC July 2026 Revenue Report (SEC-filed Form 6-K)
excerpt: July 2026 revenue was approximately NT$467.58 billion, up 5.6% month over month and 44.7% year over year; January-July revenue rose 37.0%.
summary: Current primary monthly evidence extends strong demand: July revenue rose to NT$467.58 billion and January-July revenue reached NT$2,872.06 billion.
